blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — The Medical City (TMC) Clark has named a former “doctor to the barrios” and a veteran vascular neurologist and neurocritical care specialist as its new chief medical officer. Dr. Jo Ann Soliven will now lead clinical excellence and physician development at the hospital, according to a TMC Clark statement. “Dr. Soliven brings more than two decades of leadership in neurological care to the role, including prior service as TMC Clark’s neurology section head, where she played a pivotal role in strengthening the hospital’s stroke and neurocritical care services,” it said.
